comparison.objective: Safely unplug a toaster, raise a low slice and remove it with wooden tongs.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered safety actions, sustained lever holding, tong use and bimanual extraction.
comparison.success_condition: No entry while plugged in or fork movement; toast plated, lever down, tongs placed and arms returned.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual tool handling is generic; this task tests safety sequencing and spring-lever-assisted extraction rather than impact regulation and tang fracture/recovery.
